subject: Adaptive profile training must wait for exact attempt identity on frame/presentation rows
body: SOURCE finding at current main: TransitionEvent already has presentationAttemptSequence, and FrameTimelineProbe/SurfaceTransactionProbe expose expected-presentation and actual-present timing, but TransitionLab.recordFrame() and recordTransaction() do not populate presentationAttemptSequence on those rows. Therefore a Gen7 adaptive visual profile cannot safely learn presentation latency from current lab rows without cross-attempt contamination risk. Hard gate: train cadence-specific presentation-latency priors only from exact-current rows bound to the immutable PresentationAttempt identity. This is a dependency on the active causal-diagnostics lane, not a request to infer identity from temporal proximity. No production write.
